text:
Larkspur Bay Family Home – 5 min Walk to the Beach

About this space
Bring the whole family to this bright, two-story home in a quiet cul-de-sac of Larkspur Bay. The beach, the boardwalk, and the ice cream shops are a five-minute walk away, and there is a playground at the end of the street.

The space
Upstairs you will find three bedrooms. The main bedroom has a king bed and its own bathroom. The second bedroom has a queen bed, and the bunk room has two sets of bunk beds for the kids. Downstairs, the open kitchen flows into a living room with a sectional sofa and a big smart TV. Sliding glass doors open onto a screened porch and a backyard with a gas grill and a picnic table.

Guest access
You will have the entire house, the backyard, and the garage for beach gear. Bikes and boogie boards are free to use.

The neighborhood
The cul-de-sac is quiet and safe for scooters. The nearest grocery store is 1 mile away, and the farmers market runs on Sunday mornings.

Getting around
You won't need the car much. Bikes are the easiest way to get to town.

Other things to note
We live nearby and can help with anything during your stay. Call or text us at (555) 555-0182.
Address: 47 Seagrass Court, Larkspur Bay
